def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    n = len(state)
    result = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            # Get diagonal-tetrad neighbors (NE, NW, SE, SW)
            ne = state[(i-1) % n][(j+1) % n]
            nw = state[(i-1) % n][(j-1) % n]
            se = state[(i+1) % n][(j+1) % n]
            sw = state[(i+1) % n][(j-1) % n]
            tetrad = [ne, nw, se, sw]
            d_z = tetrad.count(0)
            d_p = tetrad.count(1)
            d_q = tetrad.count(2)
            result[i][j] = (d_p + 2 * d_q) % 3
    return result
